correctness.rationale: At a=3^(−1/4), direct differentiation shows gradient zero and Hessian diagonal 8/3 and off diagonal −4/3, giving eigenvalues {0,4,4}. The exact polynomial factorization g(x)=x⁴−4a³x+1=(x−a)²(x²+2ax+3a²) gives invariant diagonal GD update x_(k+1)=x_k−2ηx_k g(x_k). With δ=x−a, δ_(k+1)=δ_k−12ηa³δ_k²+O(δ_k³), and diagonal objective has leading odd cubic 12a³δ³, so the critical point is neither minimum nor maximum. For small positive δ the recurrence is monotone to 0, reciprocal increments tend to 12ηa³ and Cesàro averaging gives kδ→1/(12ηa³). Small negative δ moves away and cannot converge to another fixed point locally. An independent symbolic check verified the factorization, gradient, cubic coefficient and characteristic polynomial. No general off-diagonal basin or global GD convergence is asserted.

The underlying parabolic fixed-point rate is standard as a technique; structural specialization, not the technique, is assessed.
